files.apps/desktop/src/main/library/public-fet: URL import: fetches the page the user typed, public addresses only (undici with a lookup that refuses private ranges)
files.apps/desktop/src/main/server-api.ts: desktop main talks to its own loopback server on 127.0.0.1
files.apps/desktop/src/main/updates-service.ts: electron-updater checks GitHub Releases for a new version
files.apps/extension/src/app/background/connec: extension talks to the desktop app on 127.0.0.1
files.packages/engine/src/worker.ts: kokoro-js downloads the model files from Hugging Face on first use

hosts.api.github.com: update check reads the latest release (electron-updater feed and the manual check)
hosts.chromewebstore.google.com: link opened in the user's browser to install the extension
hosts.github.com: release page opened in the user's browser
hosts.speakkit.app: links to the product site opened in the user's browser
